verdict.rationale: Relay documents role definition, card-level spend limits, and multi-step approval rules (relay-docs-2, relay-docs-17), which supports basic team permissioning, but there's no evidence of granular controls segmented by location or department, nor detailed role-based access management. A community review also notes 'issues with permissions' as a minor complaint (relay-comm-2), suggesting the feature isn't fully robust in practice. Missing for 10: department/location-level permission scoping, audit trail of permission changes, and independent confirmation that role granularity works reliably at scale.
